The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a bodypart the can be removed at the [[preparation place]]. 

Like [[Heart]] and [[Intestine]], each brain contains some skulls <span style = "display:inline-block;">{{Skull|white}}{{Skull|red}}</span> and removing the brain will remove those skulls whereas inserting a brain (in a body that doesn't have one anymore) will add them back. 

See the [[corpses]] page for more information on corpse rating and the effects of the various operations or the [[preparation place]] workstation page for the list of other body parts that can be removed there.

A standard brain will always have random stats of 1-3 {{Skull|white}}'s and/or 1-3 {{Skull|red}}'s these stats are initially hidden. Progress along the [[Inquisitor]]'s quest line will eventually teach you to identify a [[Dark brain]], the prerequisite for the Cultist perk (cost of {{Techpoint|Blue|300}}), which identifies {{Skull|white}}'s in organs. The most common content of a brain is <span style = "display:inline-block;">{{Skull|white}}{{Skull|white}}</span>.  See table below for various possibilities.
